suggestions.title: Review the policy-gated automation proposal
suggestions.body: Prepare a policy-gated action proposal for the highlighted GUI target, but wait for explicit user confirmation before any automation runs.
suggestions.reasoning: The recorded LLM suggestion resolves the visible GUI target to a proposal only. It must not auto-execute because external automation requires consent and audit.

suggestions.title: Summarize why the proposal needs confirmation
suggestions.body: Open the explanation in chat using the suggestion id only so the raw screen context is not copied into feedback IPC.
suggestions.reasoning: Feedback and explain actions should reference the suggestion id. The recorded payload body and reasoning stay in the local UI state.
